source: The only example answer of checkproxyverification in Etherscan's API documentation, https://docs.etherscan.io/api-reference/endpoint/checkproxyverification, read 2026-11-03 and 2026-11-04. The guid is a placeholder and the headers are reduced to the content type. Not seen live: on 2026-11-04 Etherscan linked a proxy whose source it had not verified.

body.result: The proxy contract at 0xcbdcd3815b5f975e1a2c944a9b2cd1c985a1cb7f does not seem to be verified. Please verify and publish the contract source before proceeding with this proxy verification.
